question:
The following pie charts show the data of the number of appeared and passed students of class 12 in sections A, B, C, D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4034fc26467c525554d1439f934e04959785a3f6b40e6d68947767d1ee3e70f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f74493f812b5f697a82ac1a2a463cc001947c8f5d4f3ceb32618d11877146772.png] 

How many students failed in Section C?
solution:
**Given:**

The total number of students appeared = 1800

The total number of students passed = 800

The students appeared from section C = 100° 

The percentage of students passed from section C = 25%

**Concept:**

X\%={Xover100}

A circle has total = 360° 

**Calculation:**

Let the total failed students from section C be X

The total appeared students from section C = {{100over360}times {1800}}={100times 5}=500

The total passed students from section C = {{25over100}times 800}=200

The total failed students from section C = X = 500 - 200 = 300

**∴ The required result will be 300.**
